One token for thousands of data endpoints across many providers (DataForSEO, SERP, backlinks, social, people and company enrichment, scraping), with no account at each provider. Calls are billed per call from a prepaid treg balance. Apps reach the catalog only: `/call/<id>`, `/catalog` and `/tasks`.

## API key

1. Sign in at [treg.to](https://treg.to) and create a team kept for this Gateway, with no tools or connected accounts of its own: every app on the Gateway shares its balance.
2. Add funds to the team (new verified accounts get $1 once).
3. Create a team API key from the dashboard, or run `treg org agent-new everyapp` with the treg CLI. Use a team-scoped key, never your personal sign-in token.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add treg
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  treg: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls treg's [API](https://treg.to/llms.txt) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show treg` shows the key as set.

**Cost:** Per call at the provider's price, from the team's prepaid treg balance; the X-Treg-Cost-Micro response header says what a call cost (micro-USD). A 4xx or 5xx from the provider costs nothing.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20treg).
